# thunder_slb_template_dns_category_lookup (Resource)

`thunder_slb_template_dns_category_lookup`: Configure web-category list for DNS domains matching (Up to 8 lists)

__PLACEHOLDER__



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category_name` (String) category-list name
- `dns_name` (String) Dns_name

### Optional

- `drop` (Number) Deny matching DNS domains
- `permit` (Number) Permit matching DNS domains
- `respond` (Number) Respond to matching DNS domains
- `respond_cname_str` (String) CNAME to respond (Canonical name)
- `respond_ip_addr` (String) Type A record to respond (IPv4 address)
- `respond_ipv6_addr` (String) TYPE AAAA record to respond (IPv6 address)
- `respond_nxdomain` (Number) Respond with NXDOMAIN
- `response_ttl` (Number) Set response TTL in seconds (TTL value in seconds)
- `uuid` (String) uuid of the object

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
